description: This Java class 'KafkaEdgeGrpcSession' manages gRPC sessions for edge communication via Kafka, including processing edge events, managing consumers, and cleaning up Kafka topics.

classes.name: KafkaEdgeGrpcSession
classes.description: Manages Kafka-based gRPC sessions for edge communication, including processing edge events, managing consumers, and cleanup.

methods.name: processMsgs
methods.description: Processes a batch of edge event notification messages, converts them, and sends downlink messages.

methods.name: migrateEdgeEvents
methods.description: Overrides to process edge events migration.

methods.name: processEdgeEvents
methods.description: Starts or manages the edge event consumer for processing edge events.

methods.name: processHighPriorityEvents
methods.description: Handles processing of high priority events, setting a flag during processing.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Stops consumers and shuts down executor services.

methods.name: awaitConsumerTermination
methods.description: Waits for consumer executor to terminate.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Deletes Kafka topics and consumer groups related to edge event notifications.
